spec.objective: Finish and verify the JDT.LS ForgeGradle classpath priming in the validation kernel so the LSP layer stops emitting target-mismatched Minecraft deprecations on Forge 1.20.1 workloads. Concretely: make JDT.LS resolve ForgeGradle's deobfuscated recomp jar (forge-1.20.1-...-recomp.jar) so omni32-loader's lsp layer no longer reports the false 'ResourceLocation(String, String) deprecated since 1.20.6'.
constraints: Priming scaffold already exists in packages/validation-kernel/src/layers/lsp.ts: primeGradleEclipse() runs `gradlew eclipse`; buildJdtlsWorkspaceSettings() sends NESTED java.* settings and sets java.import.gradle.enabled=false when priming succeeded. Finish/repair this, do not rewrite wholesale.

Current blocker (from JDT.LS .metadata/.log): JDT.LS's GradleProjectImporter still runs ('Importing Gradle project(s)') and overwrites the primed .classpath (recomp jar entry disappears), so the false deprecation persists. Root cause: Buildship Tooling-API import does not replicate ForgeGradle's dependency replacement and resolves a 1.20.6+ Minecraft.

DO NOT edit omni32-loader source. new ResourceLocation(String, String) is the CORRECT, non-deprecated API on Minecraft 1.20.1 (ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath does not exist until 1.20.5). Migrating it would break the build.
DO NOT add @SuppressWarnings or weaken zero-tolerance globally (CLAUDE001/002).
.classpath/.project/.settings are gitignored, regenerable IDE artifacts — safe to regenerate, never commit them.
Keep the lsp_prime_gradle_eclipse config flag (default on) as the kill switch.
All mutations pass the validation kernel before disk write; operate through the gate.
acceptance_criteria: Re-running `janus execute run -t task-3f81e9b4-e7df-4c49-810e-7d93931eccef` shows the lsp layer PASS (no ResourceLocation deprecation), with ast/rules/build still passing.

If JDT.LS cannot be made to honor the primed classpath, instead implement a documented, narrowly-scoped fallback (e.g. treat ForgeGradle MC-version-mismatch LSP deprecations as harness_infra via gate-infra signature, or LSP-advisory for forge profiles) — and justify it in the patch result. Do NOT silently disable LSP.
Full `pnpm --filter @aether/validation-kernel test` suite green, including a new test covering buildJdtlsWorkspaceSettings nested shape + enabled flag.
`pnpm typecheck` passes workspace-wide; zero new warnings.
No regression for non-Forge LSP workloads (priming is best-effort/no-op when no gradlew or flag off).
